title: This Excel Date Can Mean TWO Different Days 😬 #excel #csv #powerquery
description: 03/08/2026 can mean March 8 or 3 August depending on locale. This realistic Excel/Power Query walkthrough shows how to use Change Type > Using Locale and then verify the interpreted day/month. #excel #csv #powerquery #datacleaning
visual_style: realistic spreadsheet screen demo with selective overlays
research_signal: Recent Excel community discussion continues to highlight mixed date-format cleanup as recurring manual work.

captions.text: This date can mean two different days.
The wrong locale can interpret the CSV incorrectly.
Changing the cell format is not the real fix.
Power Query → Change Type → Using Locale.
Choose Date and the source file's locale.
Then verify the day and month.
Format changes appearance. Locale changes interpretation.
